name: 4-HO-MiPT
toxicities: The toxicity and long-term health effects of 4-HO-MiPT have not been researched and the exact toxic dose is unknown, because its history of human use is very short. Anecdotal evidence from the community suggests that trying it only at low to moderate doses and using it sparingly has no negative health effects, though nothing can be fully guaranteed.
effectsSummary: 4-HO-MiPT as having contradictory properties: relaxing, dulling and mildly sedating while also producing a distinct bodily stimulation, which distinguishes it from psilocybin mushrooms or 4-AcO-DMT. Its body high is a pleasant, warm, soft and encompassing tingling that builds after onset and peaks at the peak of the experience, and it causes internal temperature sense fluctuations with sudden chills or fever. Its effects index is built on anecdotal user reports, and adverse effects become more likely at higher doses, potentially including addiction, serious injury or death.

summary: 4-HO-MiPT is a tryptamine psychedelic with contradictory relaxing and stimulating properties and a pronounced tingling body high. It should not be combined with dissociatives or other psychedelics, and its toxicity and long-term health effects have not been researched.
